## Objectives

- Defeat 80 Battlements or Inner Ward monsters ([Spore Puff](../monsters/spore_puff.md), [Hoarder Shroom](../monsters/hoarder_shroom_keep.md), [Wallcreeper Cap](../monsters/wallcreeper_cap.md), [Crowncap](../monsters/crowncap.md))
